blind.description: A stylized carved stone corbel or architectural bracket with tiered/stepped profiles, chamfered edges, and subtle surface cracks. The surfaces are completely solid and continuous with stylized hand-painted textures in olive-grey and tan stone hues. It stands upright directly on its flat bottom edge without an additional base or plinth.
blind.from_above: A small rectangular stone profile with a segmented seam dividing a slightly stepped upper section.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 1.5 to 2 feet tall, reaching about knee-height compared to the 5 ft 9 in figure, and about 1 foot wide.
